description: This file defines an API for subscribing to changes in the current working directory, including registration, notification, and reparenting functionality.

methods.name: chdir_notify_register
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be notified when the directory changes.

methods.name: chdir_notify_reparent
methods.description: Reparents a relative path from an old root to a new root.

methods.name: chdir_notify
methods.description: Changes directory and notifies registered callbacks.

methods.name: reparent_relative_path
methods.description: Adjusts a relative path based on new and old current working directories.

ctags.name: chdir_notify_callback
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(const char * name,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd,void * data)
